dict.string: Vello uses your local network to stay in step with Vello on your other Mac.
Vello opens research pages in new Chrome windows on its VM screens, and closes them when it's done.
Vello uses your microphone so you can talk to it
Vello needs screen recording access so Pointer Assistant can see your screen and help you.
Vello uses speech recognition to transcribe your voice when you talk to it
